headline: Marvel Exec Addresses Wonder Man Cancellation
post:
Marvel television head Brad Winderbaum recently discussed the surprising cancellation of Wonder Man. Although the hit Disney+ series earned an Emmy nomination and a 91% Rotten Tomatoes score, it was ultimately cancelled despite an initial season two renewal. Winderbaum stated that he fought for the show and still hopes Yahya Abdul-Mateen II and Ben Kingsley could return as their characters in the future. 🎬

Are you disappointed in Wonder Man's cancellation?

#Marvel #WonderMan #MCU
original_title: Marvel Exec Addresses Controversial Wonder Man Cancellation & Compares It to Daredevil’s Revival

headline: Boba Fett's Empire Strikes Back Blaster at Auction
post:
A very special piece of Star Wars history is heading to Heritage Auctions next month. The screen-used EE-3 carbine blaster rifle wielded by actor Jeremy Bulloch in The Empire Strikes Back is going up for sale with a starting price of $100,000.

This unique prop was previously sold for over $600,000 in a winter auction last year. Original trilogy items like this one rarely appear on the market.

Would you rather own this screen-used bounty hunter weapon or a rare action figure?

#StarWars #BobaFett #Collectibles
original_title: You Can Buy an Actual Boba Fett Star Wars Movie Prop for a Fraction of the Price of His Rarest Action Figure

headline: VisionQuest reveals the six AI characters
post:
According to /Film, the new sequel series "VisionQuest" follows the resurrected White Vision as he attempts to restore his own humanity and emotions. In his quest, he utilizes the voices in his head for company. The show reveals that Vision has backed up several artificial intelligences developed by Tony Stark inside his own programming.

These strings of code live together in a digital mind palace, each represented by a unique human avatar. The group includes Tony's early workshop robotic arms Dum-E and U, J.A.R.V.I.S., F.R.I.D.A.Y., E.D.I.T.H., and Ultron. James D'Arcy portrays the human avatar of J.A.R.V.I.S., while James Spader physically appears as the human avatar for Ultron.

Further updates regarding the series will follow.

#VisionQuest #Marvel #WhiteVision
original_title: VisionQuest: All 6 AI Characters And Their MCU Origins Explained

headline: Josh Hutcherson and Mackenzie Davis join Mister Miracle
post:
DC Studios has officially found the stars for the upcoming animated Mister Miracle series! Josh Hutcherson will voice Scott Free, while Mackenzie Davis will take on the role of Big Barda.

Peter Safran confirmed the casting, revealing that all eight episodes are written by Tom King, who also serves as showrunner. Nathan Fillion will additionally appear as Green Lantern Guy Gardner.

Are you excited to see this talented duo bring these classic characters to life? 

#MisterMiracle #DCStudios #JoshHutcherson
original_title: DC’s Animated Mister Miracle Series Finds Its Heroes in Hunger Games, Station Eleven Stars

headline: Showcase #4: Barry Allen's Historic Debut
post:
Showcase #4 is a massive milestone for DC Comics, introducing Barry Allen as the next Flash and widely considered to have kicked off the Silver Age of comic books after World War II. 

A CGC GD/VG 3.0 graded copy of the issue is reportedly going for almost $10,000 at Heritage Auctions. It features his origin story, iconic ring suit, and early showdowns with Turtle Man and Mazdan.

What, according to you, is the best way The Flash has used his speed powers?

#TheFlash #DCComics #BarryAllen
original_title: This Vintage Issue Not Only Features The First Appearance Of Barry Allen As Flash But It’s a Major Comics Milestone

headline: Jeremy Renner teases West Coast Avengers
post:
Clint Barton might not appear in Avengers: Doomsday, but the actor behind the hero has sparked major speculation. According to ComicBook.com, Jeremy Renner shared an Instagram story featuring signed "West Coast Avengers and Hawkeye comic books". Naturally, this has followers wondering if the California-based team could finally arrive in the Marvel Cinematic Universe.

While the actor knows how to engage fans, he was reportedly "signing at an event" where someone brought the comics. Still, the Disney+ series previously laid the groundwork by pairing Clint Barton with Kate Bishop. The secondary team has historically included heroes like Tony Stark, Moon Knight, and Scarlet Witch.

There is currently no official confirmation from Marvel Studios about this project. However, the Multiverse Saga will eventually bring a fresh start. Could this be the perfect spot for our favorite archer?

Who is your favorite member of this squad?

#Hawkeye #WestCoastAvengers #Marvel
original_title: Jeremy Renner’s Latest Hawkeye Tease Has Marvel Fans Ready for the Next Major MCU Team

headline: Peter Safran on the future of Lanterns
post:
DC Studios co-chief Peter Safran shared an update on the upcoming HBO series Lanterns! While the show hasn't scored a second season renewal yet, a potential pickup could happen depending on how things go in the writers' room. Safran hasn't confirmed an exact date for when an announcement might arrive, so we will just have to stay tuned for more news.
